label: Claude Opus 5.5
output:
**Lee – the dumper**

I know you'd rather read this than have me going on at you in the van, so here are the sums.

**What we spent this year**

We hired the tracked dumper from Sittingbourne 14 days this year. At 85 quid a day plus 30 delivery each time, it came to roughly £1,600 all in. That money's gone and we've nothing to show for it.

**What's on offer**

A bloke in Faversham is selling a 2019 500kg tracked dumper for £1,650 ono. He says new tracks were fitted last spring. Split halves, that's £825 each, and probably less if we haggle him down.

**Does it add up?**

- At this year's use, it pays for itself in about a year.
- If we only used it half as much, it's about two years.
- That's before servicing and repairs, so I'm not pretending it's free money. But we've already got 3 patio digs and the Boughton drive booked for spring, so I can't see us using it less.
- If it doesn't work out, we sell it on. These things hold their value, so we wouldn't be throwing £825 each down the drain.

**The bits that don't show on the sums**

Remember Hernhill in September, when the hire place didn't have one? We barrowed 6 ton of muck, it took 2 extra days, and your back was gone for a week. Then there was the time the delivery driver turned up at 11 and we lost half the morning standing about. With our own we just load it on and go.

**How we'd run it**

- It lives in my lean-to at the yard. It's covered, so it's out of the weather.
- Servicing gets split 50/50.
- Whoever breaks it pays for it. That keeps it fair and stops any arguments.

**Saturday**

Come and have a look at it with me this Saturday. You can kick the tracks, give it a run and ask him whatever you want. If you're not happy once you've seen it, fair enough, no hard feelings. I just don't want someone else getting in first while we're umming and ahhing.

Fifteen years we've been doing this. I reckon it's about time we owned the kit instead of renting it.

Let me know if you're in for Saturday.
